rationale: Pulp-owned Linux plug-in host fix. pump_x_events() in plugin_view_host_linux.cpp now acts on the ConfigureNotify a DAW's XResizeWindow produces: the editor takes the window's new size, resizes its surfaces through the existing set_size() sizing, notifies the resize callback once per drain and repaints. Before, a host-driven resize left the editor at its old size, and the swapchain kept being scaled onto the window. The editor's own set_size() echo is a no-op. Only Pulp-owned host and test code changes; the render sources are untouched. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'X11 plugin host follows a resize the host applied to its window'
